zh-Hant.title: 新家園協會——親子寵物共融活動
zh-Hant.kicker: 親子心連心工作坊活動花絮
zh-Hant.summary: 療心教育由 Miss Helen 及 Kimberly Chak 為少數族裔家庭帶來「親子心連心」工作坊，透過角色對調、寵物互動和「我訊息」練習，探索更輕鬆、更有愛的親子溝通方式。
description: 療心教育非常感謝新家園協會的邀請，由 Miss Helen 及 Kimberly Chak 為少數族裔家庭帶來「親子心連心」工作坊，與家長及小朋友一同探索更輕鬆、更有愛的親子溝通方式。
角色對調環節是工作坊最受歡迎的環節之一。小朋友模仿爸媽平日嘮叨的神態，爸媽亦放開懷抱扮演調皮小孩，現場笑聲不斷。透過親身體驗，家長與孩子從對方的角度重新理解彼此。
工作坊亦邀請到兩位可愛嘉賓——牛奶妹與 Milo，與參加者進行寵物互動。透過「寵物界線」的隱喻和「我訊息」的運用，大家在輕鬆歡笑的氣氛中體會換位思考的力量，學習更有效的表達方式。
育兒路上並不孤單，互相理解能令愛變得更輕鬆。期待未來有更多機會與各位家長同行，共建更融洽的親子關係。

工作坊还邀请了两位可爱嘉宾——牛奶妹与 Milo，与参加者进行宠物互动。通过「宠物界线」的比喻和「我讯息」的运用，大家在轻松欢笑的气氛中体会换位思考的力量，学习更有效的表达方式。

en.title: New Home Association — Parent-Child Pet Inclusion Activity
en.summary: Healing Education, with Miss Helen and Kimberly Chak, brought a Parent-Child Heart-to-Heart workshop to ethnic minority families through New Home Association. Role reversal, pet interaction and “I-messages” helped families explore more relaxed and caring ways to communicate.
description: Healing Education sincerely thanks New Home Association for the invitation. Miss Helen and Kimberly Chak brought a Parent-Child Heart-to-Heart workshop to ethnic minority families, inviting parents and children to explore more relaxed and caring ways to communicate with one another.

The role-reversal activity was one of the workshop’s most popular moments. Children imitated the way their parents might nag, while parents opened up and played mischievous children. The room was filled with laughter, and the experience helped parents and children understand one another from a different perspective.

The workshop also welcomed two lovely guests, Milk Girl and Milo, for a pet interaction session. Through the metaphor of pet boundaries and the use of “I-messages”, participants experienced the power of perspective-taking and practised more effective ways to express themselves in a relaxed and joyful atmosphere.

No one is alone on the parenting journey. Mutual understanding can make love feel easier. We look forward to walking alongside more parents in the future and building warmer, more harmonious parent-child relationships together.
